name: zoltasoft/cqrs
description: CQRS application layer for PHP 8.2+ with command/query buses, decorator-based middleware pipeline, Result/Option monads, repository abstractions with caching, transaction management, domain event dispatching, and automatic handler discovery via attributes.

cache-zolta-maps: @php artisan zolta:routes:cache --quiet || echo "Zolta: routes cache skipped (Laravel app not fully set up yet)"
scripts.test: APP_SERVICES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-services.php APP_PACKAGES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-packages.php APP_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-config.php APP_ROUTES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-routes.php APP_EVENTS_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-events.php PHPUNIT_RESULT_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-phpunit.result.cache phpunit -c phpunit.xml
scripts.test:unit: APP_SERVICES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-services.php APP_PACKAGES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-packages.php APP_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-config.php APP_ROUTES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-routes.php APP_EVENTS_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-events.php PHPUNIT_RESULT_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-phpunit.result.cache phpunit -c phpunit.xml --testsuite Unit
scripts.test:integration: APP_SERVICES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-services.php APP_PACKAGES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-packages.php APP_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-config.php APP_ROUTES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-routes.php APP_EVENTS_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-events.php PHPUNIT_RESULT_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-phpunit.result.cache phpunit -c phpunit.xml --testsuite Integration
scripts.analyse: APP_SERVICES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-services.php APP_PACKAGES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-packages.php APP_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-config.php APP_ROUTES_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-routes.php APP_EVENTS_CACHE=/tmp/cqrs-events.php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse
scripts.md: HOME=/tmp PDEPEND_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pdepend-cache vendor/bin/phpmd src text phpmd.xml --exclude 'src/Symfony/Console/Command/*'
